tei:div.tei:p: ༈ rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' 'bum/

glegs bam ka pa/ 1 gzhon nu'i dus kyi rtsom thor bu'i skor phyogs gcig tu byas pa dbyar gyi ne'u sing sil ma/ 2 1$1000090snyan ngag gi rgyan gyi bstan bcos me long ma'i sarga gsum gyi bstan don dper brjod kyi sgo nas 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs la bsngags pa dri med padma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 3 mtsho skyes bla ma mchog gi rnam thar la bsngags shing smon tshig tu bsdebs pa dbyangs can dga' byed dri med utpa la'i do shal rab mdzes tshangs pa'i mgul rgyan/ 4 ston pa mtshungs med la bsngags pa bya dka'i re'u mig blo gros rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng*/ 5 thub mchog don kun grub pa'i rnam thar la bsngags pa bya dka'i re'u mig rnam par spel ba dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs zab mo'i nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ 6 karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bstod dbyangs/ 7 mchod phreng nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo'i drwa ba me tog sprin gyi lding khang*/ 8 bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma la bstod pa 'chi med nor bu'i tambu ra/ 9 rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po mda' mnun zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa la bsngags pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa e waṃ phyag rgya'i zlos gar bde chen bzhad pa'i glu dbyangs/ 10 kho bo dpal karma pa bco lnga pa'i skyes rabs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa ngo mtshar bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng dri med zla zer/ 11 bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skor byin rlabs sprin gyi bla re/ 12 bla ma'i rnal 'byor bde chen grub pa'i thig le/ 13 mnyam med rje btsun sgam po pa rin po che'i zhal gdams gsang lam bla ma sgrub pa'i man ngag gi sgrub thabs phrin las kyi byang bu bklag chog tu bkod pa nyi ma'i snying po ye shes rgyan gyi bla bre/ 14 dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen rgyal ba blo gros mtha' yas gtso bor bzhugs pa'i rgya mtsho lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen po mchod cing sgrub pa'i rim pa rnam grol mchog ster/

15 gsar rnying bka' gter lhag pa'i lha rnams kyi sgom bzlas kyi skor sna tshogs nor bu'i char rgyun/ 16 dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog bcas nyung ngur bsdus pa/ 17 bsnyen yig / 18 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs tshogs mchod bcas nyung ngur bsdebs pa ye shes char rgyun/ 19 gsang bdag nyi ma mdung gang ma g.ya' bzang lugs karma chags med nas brgyud pa'i khungs btsun gyi dmigs 'don kha gsal khyer bder bkod pa/ 20 tshig bdun sgrub thabs zab mo smin sgrol lag len mtshams sbyor gyis brgyan pa padma'i lding khang*/ 21 tshig bdun bla sgrub zab mo'i yum bka' mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dbang bskur mtshams sbyor gyis brgyan pa bde chen grub pa'i zil mngar/ 22 spar byang smon tshig / ༈ rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' 'bum/ glegs bam kha pa/ 1 bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i las byang me tog phreng mdzes kyi mngon rtogs cung zad spros pa dang nyer mkho'i zur 'debs nyung ngu rin chen snying po ze'u 'bru/ 2 bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i phrin las rgyun khyer lus dkyil gtsor bton gyi lugs shin tu bsdus pa snying po dam pa'i rgyan/ 3 bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i tshogs sgrub sman sgrub sbrel ma dang 'brel bar sgrub dbang tshang ma bskur skabs kyi gtong thun/ 4 bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i las bzhi sbyin sreg gi cho ga shin tu bsdus pa bklag chog mar bkod pa yid bzhin 'phrul gyi 'dod 'jo/ 5 bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor la mkho ba'i mnan pa'i lag len ngag 'don 'khor lo nag po'i 'thib gnon/ 6 gsang gling bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang chen mo'i slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus snying por dril ba/ 7 bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga bkra shis brtsegs pa/ 8 bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i 'jam dbyangs blo 'phel shes rab ral gri'i rjes gnang gi sgrub pa'i yig cha'i rgyud 'debs/

9 bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i tshe sgrub bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbang zin/ 10 yongs dge mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dag snang pakshi'i bla sgrub kyi bsnyen rkyang bya tshul gyi yi ge bde chen grub pa'i thig le/ 11 bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi zhal gdams snying byang yid bzhin nor bu'i le'u bcu bzhi pa las/ mchog gi dngos grub mngon du byed pa bdud rtsi sman gyi lag len ngag 'don nyung ngur bkrol ba/ 12 bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi spyi dang bye brag phrin las gang la'ang 'brel chog pa'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg / 13 klong chen snying thig gi bla sgrub thig le rgya can gyi smin byed ye shes mchog sbyin gyi mtshams sbyor nyung ngur bkod pa bde chen thig le/ 14 dpal bka' 'dus kyi cha lag rnal 'byor rgyun gyi las sbyor las/ rim pa dang po bar chad bzlog pa dmar chen gtor ma'i las rim gyi lag len/ 15 mchog gling rten 'brel chos bcu'i bla ma'i thugs sgrub skor gsum gyi gsang sgrub rdo rje drag rtsal gyi phrin dbang gi zur rgyan bklags chog tu bkod pa pha lam rdo rje'i lhun po/ 16 gro lod rgyun khyer/ 17 gu ru rdo rje gro lod hūm̐ gi sgrub thabs gdug pa kun 'dul gyi smin dbang mtshams sbyor gyi brgyan pa rdo rje'i zhun thig / 18 'jam mgon gter byon rdo rje gro lod gsang ba hūm̐ gi sgrub pa'i bsnyen sgrub zin thun gyi rtsa tho nyung gsal du bkod pa rdo rje'i snang ba sbyin pa'i nyin byed/ 19 sprul pa'i gter chen rdo rje gling pa'i zab chos rdzogs pa chen po hūm̐ skor snying thig gi thun mong spyi'i sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don kun tu bzang po'i 'jug ngogs/ 20 rdor sems sngon 'gro/ 21 dpal bka' 'dus kyi phrin las nar ma rin chen snying po'i zur 'debs rin chen phra tshom/

22 mchog gling snyan brgyud a ti zab don snying tig gi gur drag ye shes zil gnon gyi smin grol lag len mtshams sbyor ye shes snying po'i rgyan/ 23 dpal bka' 'dus kyi cha lag rnal 'byor rgyun gyi las sbyor las/ rim pa gnyis pa mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa bdud rtsi sman gyi lag len ngag 'don khrigs su bsdebs pa/ 24 dpal bka' 'dus kyi tshogs sgrub sman sgrub sbrel ma'i skabs nyer mkho'i gtong thun rnams phyogs gcig tu bkod pa rin chen lha'i sil snyan/ 25 dpal bka' 'dus kyi cha lag rnal 'byor rgyun gyi las sbyor las/ rim pa gsum pa phrin las myur du 'grub byed las bzhi me mchod kyi lag len ngag 'don khrigs su bsdebs pa/ 26 bka' 'dus sman sgrub gtor bzlog bcas kyi zin tho/ 27 mchog gling zab bdun rgyud zab sgyu 'phrul las/ rgya che ba lcags byang ma'i chos sde'i zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho 'dren byed zla ba'i shing rta/ 28 mchog gling zab bdun rgyud zab sgyu 'phrul las/ rgya che ba lcags byang ma'i chos sde'i khro bo dam brgyan gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho gsal byed nyi ma'i snang ba/ 29 mchog gling dam chos shog sde drug pa las/ rdor sems thugs kyi snying po'i dbang bzhi gter gzhung lugs su bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor 'od gsal mkha' khyab/ 30 spar byang smon tshig / ༈ rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' 'bum/ glegs bam ga pa/ 1 'ja' tshon zhi khro nges don snying po'i dbang bskur chen mo'i lag len mtshams sbyor nyung ngu bklag chog tu bkod pa nges don snying por 'jug pa'i lam bzang*/ 2 mchog gling zab bdun rgyud zab sgyu 'phrul las/ rgya che ba lcags byang ma'i chos sde zhi khro yongs dril ngan song dong sprugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rgyud don snang byed rab gsal nyi zla'i snang ba/

3 gu ru'i thugs dam zab pa skor bdun gyi drag sngags 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed lcags byang ma'i gtor bzlog gi 'don zin/ 4 gshin rje'i srung bzlog / 5 tshe gsang brgyud 'debs/ 6 tshe sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa la brten nas tshom bu tshogs sgrub la 'jug pa'i zur 'debs 'chi med dngos 'grub 'byung ba'i nor bu dpal gyi snying po/ 7 rata gling tshe gsang yang gsang gud sbas kyi lhan thabs mdor bsdus tshe dbang 'dod 'jo/ 8 ratna'i tshe sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa'i tshogs sgrub kyi gtong thun/ 9 gter gsar rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bcud dril gyi cha lag tshe sgrub 'chi med srog thig gi zur 'debs 'chi med nor bu'i phreng ba/ 10 gter gsar rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bcud dril gyi cha lag tshe sgrub 'chi med srog thig gi rtsa ba'i dbang bskur rgyas par phye ba 'chi med nor bu padma'i phreng ba/ 11 gter gsar phur pa yang gsang bcud dril gyi cha lag tshe sgrub 'chi med srog tig gi dbang gi mtshams sbyor nyung ngur spros pa 'chi med nor bu'i bum bzang*/ 12 gter gsar phur pa yang gsang bcud dril gyi cha lag tshe sgrub 'chi med srog tig gi tshe dbang snying po bsdus pa 'chi med chu rgyun/ 13 rdo rje phur pa yang gsang phrin las bcud dril las/ gtor dbang ye shes spyi blug gi mtshams sbyor ye shes bcud 'bebs/ 14 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi bsgom bzlas 'gro don mkha' khyab ma'i zin bris nyung bsdus 'gro don char rgyun/ 15 yang gter thugs rje chen po'i padma zhi khro'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor padma snang ba'i rgyan/ 16 mchog gling thugs rje chen po padma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ 17 thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs padma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i phyi sgrub bsnyen pa'i byang bu padma'i smyu gu/ 18 thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs padma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i phyi sgrub kyi nye bsnyen gyi las byang khrigs su bsdebs pa rgyal ba'i sras kyi 'jug ngogs padma'i lcugs ma/

19 thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs padma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i nang sgrub kyi las byang bltas chog tu bkod pa padma'i 'dab phreng*/ 20 thugs rje chen po padma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gsang ba tshogs sgrub chen mo'i lag len khrigs su bsdebs pa rnam grol sgo chen padma'i snying po/ 21 mchog gling thugs rje chen po padma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i phyi nang gsang sgrub dang 'brel ba'i phan nus zab mo'i smin grol 'bog pa'i lag len mtshams sbyor dang bcas pa padma'i phreng ba/ 22 mchog gling thugs rje chen po padma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i las tshogs rgud pa rjes 'dzin gyi nang tshan/ tshe nyams rgud pa gso ba'i phrin dbang gi mtshams sbyor padma'i zil mngar/ 23 thugs rje chen po padma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bklag chog tu bkod pa padma'i 'dzum phreng*/ 24 thugs rje chen po padma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bklag chog tu bkod pa padma'i dga' tshal/ 25 chos dbang bla ma gsang 'dus kyi them med sgom sgrub gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs phyag rdor gtum po me lce phreng ba'i las byang bklag chog tu bkod pa/ 26 thugs rje chen po padma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbang gi sbyin sreg bklag chog tu bkod pa padma'i lcags kyu/ 27 thugs rje chen po padma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i drag po'i sbyin sreg bklag chog tu bkod pa padma'i 'od rnon/ 28 nyang gter rta mgrin yang phyung nag po'i rgyun khyer gnam lcags 'bar ba'i zhun thig / 29 spar byang smon tshig / ༈ rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' 'bum/ glegs bam nga pa/ 1 rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i smin grol 'bog pa'i skabs kyi phyag len nyer mkho'i zur 'debs mtshams sbyor rigs bcas nyung gsal du bkod pa 'dod rgu 'jo ba'i gter bum/

2 spar byang smon tshig / ༈ rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' 'bum/ glegs bam ca pa/ 1 rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i smin grol 'bog pa'i skabs kyi phyag len nyer mkho'i zur 'debs mtshams sbyor rigs bcas nyung gsal du bkod pa 'dod rgu 'jo ba'i gter bum pod gnyis pa/ 2 spar byang smon tshig / ༈ rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' 'bum/ glegs bam cha pa/ 1 rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i smin grol 'bog pa'i skabs kyi phyag len nyer mkho'i zur 'debs mtshams sbyor rigs bcas nyung gsal du bkod pa 'dod rgu 'jo ba'i gter bum gyi mtha' rten/ 2 chos gling gtum po ser sbrogs kyi byab khrus gdon bkrol gyi mtshams sbyor ye shes rdo rje'i chu rgyun/ 3 snyan brgyud phrin las phur pa'i gnad tig gi smad las drag po'i srung bzlog gsad pa'i las rim khyer bder bkod pa srid pa thal 'byin rdo rje'i tshon cha/ 4 snyan brgyud phur pa'i gdab kha la nye bar mkho ba'i zur 'debs cung zad bkod pa/ 5 bla ma'i thugs sgrub rnam pa gnyis dang phur pa spyi khyab kyi tshogs sgrub skabs nyer mkho'i gtong thun rdo rje'i rgyud mang*/ 6 mchog gling thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi cha lag sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel gyi lha so so'i phrin dbang gi lag len mtshams sbyor byin rlabs bcud sbyin/ 7 sgrol chog 'don zin/ 8 sgrol chog zur 'debs/ 9 bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi cha lag sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel gyi las bzhi'i me mchod me shel nor bu'i dkyil 'khor/ 10 tshe g.yang rgyun khyer/ 11 dag snang 'chi med tsanḍa lī'i sgrub thabs kyi zin bris bltas pas 'grub pa tshe dbang bcud 'dren/ 12 gsang thig yum bka' mkha' 'gro bde chen rgya mtsho'i rgyun khyer nyung ngur bsdus pa ngo mtshar nor bu'i phreng mdzes/ 13 gsang thig bla ma mkha' 'gro'i me mchod sgrib gnyis 'joms byed ye shes 'od kyi dkyil 'khor/

14 klong gsal rdo rje snying po'i yan lag gi chos sde las/ bdud 'dul seng ha dmar mo'i bsnyen sgrub kyi dmigs zin snying por dril ba rdo rje'i drwa mig / 15 nor rgyun gter gzhung*/ 16 padma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun yab yum gyi phrin las 'dod rgu sprin gyi ting 'dzin chen po dang 'brel ba'i phrin dbang las tshogs kyi gsal byed zur rgyan nor bu rmad du byung ba'i char rgyun/ 17 'phags ma nor rgyun yab yum gyi rgyun khyer snying por dril ba/ 18 mchog gling ma mo rol pa spyi bsdus kyi phrin dbang gi mtshams sbyor dngos grub bum bzang mdzes byed nor bu'i rgyan phreng*/ 19 chos gling chos skyong zab mo skor dgu las/ bka' srung ye shes mgon po phyag drug he ru ka gsang mgon smug po'i phrin dbang gi mtshams sbyor lag len dpag bsam ljon pa'i phreng ba/ 20 bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi bka' srung nor bdag kun 'khyil mched gsum gyi bka' gtad bya tshul mdor bsdus don yod nor bu'i zhags pa/

21 mchog gling zur bza'i thugs dam skong drug gi bka' srung tshig brgyud dbyings kyi rgyal mo sngags srung e ka dzwa ṭa'i gsang sgrub kyi gtor chog dang 'brel ba'i srog gtad bya tshul tsitta 'bar ba'i thig le/ 22 mchog gling bka' srung zab mo skor dgu'i nang sgrub kyi yan lag mgon po dkar ser dang 'khor gyi sgos sgrub rnams kyi dbang dang srog gtad kyi lag len dpag bsam ljon pa'i yal 'dab/ 23 mchog gling gso sbyong*/ 24 mchog gling bla ma'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i cha lag nyon mongs dug lnga rang grol gyi zhal gdams dang 'brel ba'i thabs grol lam gyi zab dbang bskur ba'i phrin las dbang khrid kyi mtshams sbyor dang bcas pa ye shes rang shar/ 25 mchog gling rdzogs pa chen po gser zhun ma kun bzang thugs thig gi smin grol yongs rdzogs kyi mtshams sbyor snang yangs rgyan gyi nam mkha'/ 1$100010026 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa mchod pa'i cho ga zab mo nor bu'i sprin chen rab tu bkod pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 27 rgyal ba sras bcas kyi spyan sngar mdo sde'i lugs gtso bor bton pa'i mchod sprin 'bul ba'i cho ga khyer bde yid bzhin nam mkha'i mdzod/ 28 gsang sngags rnying ma'i nang tshan nye brgyud gter ma'i smin byed kyi rim pa spyi la khyab pa'i mtshams sbyor nyung ngur bsdus pa bdud rtsi'i sprin phung*/ 29 mtshams sbyor khol phyung*/ 30 yang gter mkha' 'gro gsang 'dus kyi sgrub mchod dkyus ma'i phrin las kyi byang bu spyi bye brag gi skong chog las sbyor bsnyen pa'i zin tho mdor bsdus dang bcas pa'i lag len khyer bder bkod pa padma rnam par bkod pa'i dga' tshal/ 31 mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ mkha' 'gro yongs rdzogs mchod cing thugs dam skong ba'i mdos kyis cho ga mkha' dbyings rol pa'i rgyan/ 32 spar byang smon tshig / ༈ rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' 'bum/

glegs bam ja pa/ 1 rje btsun dpal ldan nag po chen po'i mngon rtogs don kun sgrub byed log 'dren tshar gcod sdang ba rnam sreg gi phrin las gsal bar byas pa mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 2 mkha' 'gro'i rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams mchod cing dgyes pa skong zhing nyams chags bshags pa'i mdos kyi cho ga snang srid rol pa'i rgyan/ 3 rdor gling gter byon chung dpyad rin po che'i gces phreng las lha mo bu rdzi ma'i rten mdos kyi lhan thabs nyung gsal du bkod pa/ 4 rgyal mdos zin bris/ 1$10001005 brtan ma'i mdos zin/ 6 sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bstan srung ye shes mgon po yab yum gyi phrin las rgyun khyer du phyes pa mtshal ma'i gzhung bklags chog tu bkod pa rdo rje nor bu'i phreng ba/ 7 bstan srung 'khor lnga rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gtor 'bul phyogs gcig tu bkod pa/ 8 dpal mgon gyi gdangs dbyangs thor bu phyogs gcig tu bkod pa zab mo nā dā'i sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal mtshan/ 1$10001009 mgon po'i nyer mkho/ 10 sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bka' srung dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po 'khor bcas rten skong rbad pa'i mdos chog nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo 'bar ba'i sprin/ 11 rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams kyi mchod phrin bstod bskul skor dpa' bo rnam par rol pa'i dgyes ston/ 12 bstan srung zhing skyong dbang po 'khor bcas kyi rten skong mchod pa'i mdos chog mdor bsdus dam can dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ 13 dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po'i dgyes skong bsang dang gser skyems tshogs mchod rnams khyer bder bkod pa dngos grub dpal 'byung*/ 14 sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bka' srung dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po'i dmar chen gtor ma'i las rim dgra bgegs srog gi spu gri/ 15 srid pa ma mo'i 'khrugs skong zla zhun bdud rtsi sman gyi rol mtsho/

16 sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa'i bka' srung 'phags ma 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i rten skong gi mdos chog yongs 'du'i ljon pa'i dga' tshal/ 17 spar byang smon tshig / ༈ rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' 'bum/ glegs bam nya pa/ 1 bstan srung bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i mchod phrin rgyun khyer snying por dril ba dgyes rgu'i dpal bskyed/ 2 mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal po drag por khros pa dug gdong nag po'i mchod gtor mdor bsdus nor bu'i chu 'dzin/ 3 sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi phyag bzhes rtsa gsum gzhi bdag dang bcas pa'i bsang brngan chen mo yid bzhin dbang rgyal dngos grub 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs srid zhi'i bde legs kun 'byung*/ 4 sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang gi bstan srung 'khor lnga rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod mnga' gsol gyi rim pa phyogs gcig tu spel ba nor bu ke ta ka'i sprin phung*/ 5 dpal ldan karma pa'i gdan sa gong 'og gtso bor gyur pa'i yul gzhi'i bdag po rnams kyi bsang mchod phyogs gcig tu bkod pa bsam 'phel nor bu phreng ba/ 6 mgon po legs ldan gyi dgra chos dgra lha bcu gsum gyi bsang mchod rgyas bsdus dang 'dod gsol dgra lha dpang bstod bcas phyogs gcig tu bkod pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru tshon/ 7 rtsa gsum srung ma yul gzhi'i bdag po rnams kyi rten gnas gsas mkhar bstod pa dang rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la phyi rten rigs 'bul ba'i cho ga dgyes skong nor bu drwa ba rnam par spel ba'i sprin phreng*/ 8 sgar bsang chen mo mchod gtor bshams bkod dang brngan gtor sogs kyi bca' thabs nor bu'i me long*/ 9 yul gzhi'i gnas bdag rnams kyi bsang gsol mchod phrin skor yid bzhin re ba skong ba'i dpag bsam ljon shing*/ 10 shis par byed pa'i mchod brjod kyi skor rdzogs ldan sprin gyi lding khang*/
